answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused price movement, so renewal is unlikely to meet the mandated 18% spend reduction. Prior evidence indicates the low-cost vendor materially reduced unit cost, onboarded quickly, and invoiced accurately. However, that evidence does not yet establish delivery performance under the current 94%-of-committed-volume condition with no buffer; verify the original c2 record before commitment and treat continuity safeguards as a gating requirement.
